intro: Cursor is an AI code editor from Anysphere. You give it prompts (Inputs) and it returns code and other outputs (Suggestions) to help you write software faster. It is for developers and teams who want machine-learning coding help inside their editor.

clarity.note: You can read most of it in plain English. The liability, warranty, and class-action parts are dense all-caps blocks.

headline: Cursor won't train on your code unless you opt in, and you keep what you put in and get out.

takeaways.text: You keep your inputs and are assigned the outputs, and Anysphere will not train on your content unless you explicitly agree.
If something goes wrong, recovery is capped at the greater of six months of fees or $100, and you indemnify Anysphere for claims arising from your use.
There is no arbitration, but you waive class actions; disputes run under Texas law in Texas courts, with a shortened window to sue.
Anysphere can modify, suspend, or discontinue the Service at any time without notice, and auto-run code execution and beta features are entirely at your own risk.

decide.region: Governing law Texas; disputes proceed exclusively in state or federal courts in Wichita County or Tarrant County, Texas (Section 16.1). Personal data processed on servers in various jurisdictions including the United States; EEA and UK data may transfer to US servers under what Anysphere calls an adequate level of data protection (Privacy Policy, Section 6). No stated data-residency option.
decide.org: Shares data with service providers and subprocessors, listed at trust.cursor.com/subprocessors (Privacy Policy, Section 3); does not sell data or use it for targeted advertising (Section 6); does not train on your Content unless you opt in, it is flagged for security review, or you report it (Terms 1.3, Privacy Policy Section 2); you retain Inputs and are assigned Suggestions (Terms 5.3); Feedback is exploitable by Anysphere without compensation (Terms 5.2). Business and processor use runs on a separate customer agreement / MSA, not published here.
decide.risk: No arbitration; class and representative actions waived (Terms 16.2), with an informal 30/45-day resolution step first (16.3). Liability capped at the greater of six months of fees or $100 (15.2); no indirect damages (15.1); you indemnify Anysphere (13). Shortened limitations period: one year for federal claims, two years for state (15.3). Fees non-refundable, except a pro-rata refund if Anysphere terminates your subscription and not for your violation (4.1, 9). Service may be suspended or discontinued without notice (9, 10).

journeys.name: Product
journeys.summary: Cursor is an AI coding tool from Anysphere. You get a limited right to access it, and Anysphere keeps all ownership of the Service itself. You keep your inputs and Anysphere assigns you the outputs. Fees are non-refundable except where the law requires or where Anysphere ends your subscription and refunds the rest pro rata. One feature can run generated code automatically, and that risk is placed entirely on you.

quotes.quote: Subject to your compliance with these Terms, Anysphere grants you a limited right to access and use the Service.
You retain all of your right, title, and interest that you have in Inputs, and Anysphere hereby assigns to you all of our right, title, and interest if any in and to any Suggestions.

journeys.note: There is no uptime or service-level promise, and support is discretionary (Section 17.4).

journeys.name: Usage
journeys.summary: You must be 18 or older. A long list of restrictions applies, including no using the Service or its Suggestions to build a competing model. A separate Acceptable Use Policy applies to everyone and controls on acceptable use if it conflicts with the Terms.

quotes.quote: you may not: ... (v) use the Service or any Suggestions to develop or train a model that is competitive with the Service, or engage in model extraction or theft attacks
In the event of a conflict between this AUP and your Agreement, this AUP controls with respect to acceptable use.

journeys.note: The AUP sets the overall standard as "be a good human" and "responsible and safe for humanity", which it does not define.

journeys.name: Feedback & improvement
journeys.summary: This is where Cursor is unusually protective. It will not train on your Content unless you opt in. Three carve-outs remain: content flagged for security review, content you report, and training you explicitly agree to. Any feedback you send can be used without paying you.

quotes.quote: ANYSPHERE WILL NOT USE CONTENT TO TRAIN, OR ALLOW ANY THIRD PARTY TO TRAIN, ANY AI MODELS, UNLESS YOU'VE EXPLICITLY AGREED TO THE USE OF CONTENT FOR TRAINING.
then you grant Anysphere the right to exploit the Feedback without restriction or compensation to you.

journeys.note: There is no fixed retention period; personal data is kept "only for as long as necessary" (Privacy Policy, Section 4).

journeys.name: Legal ramifications
journeys.summary: Texas law, Texas courts. You waive class actions. There is no arbitration, but an informal resolution step comes first. Liability is capped at the greater of six months of fees or $100, and you indemnify Anysphere. Anysphere can suspend or end the Service without notice.

quotes.quote: THE AGGREGATE LIABILITY OF THE ANYSPHERE ENTITIES TO YOU ... IS LIMITED TO THE GREATER OF: (A) THE AMOUNT YOU HAVE PAID TO ANYSPHERE FOR ACCESS TO AND USE OF THE SERVICE IN THE SIX (6) MONTHS PRIOR ... OR, IF GREATER, (B) $100.
We reserve the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue the Services or your access to the Services, in whole or in part, at any time without notice to you.

journeys.note: Security is described as "commercially reasonable" measures (Privacy Policy, Section 5); the documents make no data-breach notification commitment.

flags.name: One-sided
flags.items: Anysphere may assign the Terms and your Content; you may not assign without consent (Section 17.1). Indemnity runs one way (Section 13). Anysphere can change pricing and your continued use is agreement (Section 4.2). Feedback is assigned for exploitation without compensation (Section 5.2).

flags.name: Absolute
flags.items: Suspension or discontinuation "at any time without notice to you" (Section 9). A full "AS IS" warranty disclaimer (Section 14). It may assign the Terms, including rights in your Content, "at any time without notice or consent" (Section 17.1).

flags.name: Undefined terms
flags.items: "be a good human" and "responsible and safe for humanity" (Acceptable Use Policy); "commercially reasonable" security (Privacy Policy, Section 5).

flags.name: Scope limits
flags.items: Opt-in training carve-outs for security-flagged and reported content (Privacy Policy, Section 2); shortened limitations periods (Section 15.3); business and processor use excluded from the Privacy Policy and governed by the MSA (Privacy Policy, Introduction); third-party Model Provider use policies also apply (Acceptable Use Policy); pro-rata refund only if Anysphere ends your subscription (Section 9).

flags.name: Gaps
flags.items: No fixed retention period for personal data (Privacy Policy, Section 4). No uptime, service level, or support obligation (Section 17.4). No data-breach notification commitment.
